tasks.title: Build the review tool: findings schema, submission checks and run-assigned ids
steps: Write the listed tests in specgen/review_tool_test.go and confirm they fail

Create specgen/review_tool.go with `const ToolSubmitPRDReview = "submit_prd_review"`, an internal Finding type (id, severity, section, flaw, evidence, remedy, reopens, disposition, reason) and a mutex-guarded reviewSink with set/get like prdSink

Add reviewSchema() with schema.Object holding one required `findings` array (MaxItems 30 for the schema, items an object with required severity (schema.Enum critical|major|minor), section, flaw, evidence, remedy, reopens) and no optional properties, to keep strict-mode union parameters low

Add newReviewTool(sink, round int, earlier []Finding) *core.Tool with Terminating true; Execute decodes the JSON and turns the submission back with core.ErrResult naming the problem when: >30 findings (name the count and 30); any empty severity/section/flaw/evidence/remedy (name each finding's position and empty fields, tell the reviewer to support or withdraw it); round 1 with non-empty reopens; later round with reopens naming no earlier finding id (name the finding and the unknown id); reopens of an earlier rejected finding whose evidence equals that finding's evidence after sameEvidence normalisation (name the finding and the repeated id); empty reopens with the same section and flaw text as an earlier rejected finding (name the finding and the repeated id). Check all findings and report every offender in one error, recording nothing on error
Implement normaliseEvidence (strings.Fields joined by one space) and sameEvidence(a,b) used by the repeat check
On success assign ids `R<round>-F<n>` counting from 1 in submitted order, store them in the sink and return core.OKResult with Terminate=true; an empty list is accepted
Reuse `earlier []Finding` carrying dispositions so the checks can tell rejected from accepted findings

tasks.title: Build the revision tool: schema, dispositions, keep-or-replace merge and PRD-phase checks
steps: Write the listed tests in specgen/revision_tool_test.go and confirm they fail

Create specgen/revision_tool.go with `const ToolSubmitPRDRevision = "submit_prd_revision"`, a Disposition input type (id, disposition enum accepted|rejected, reason) and a mutex-guarded revisionSink holding the revised PRD and the dispositions

Add revisionSchema(): required `body` and `dispositions`; optional `open_questions`, `relevant_files` (reuse relevantFilesArraySchema and the open-question schema from prdSchema) and `codebase_notes`; NO spec_name, title or recommended_split property (three optional properties only, to limit union parameters)

Add newRevisionTool(sink, current PRD, findings []Finding, ws) *core.Tool, Terminating true. Execute decodes then checks in order, turning back with core.ErrResult and recording nothing: every finding must have exactly one disposition (name each missing, duplicated and unknown id); a rejected disposition needs a non-blank reason (name each id); apply keep-or-replace (omitted keeps, supplied replaces, empty open_questions/relevant_files clear, empty codebase_notes keeps earlier, replacement notes passed through boundNotes); at least one accepted finding with body, open questions, relevant files and notes all identical to the PRD under revision is an error saying the accepted findings left the PRD unchanged

Share the body checks with submitPRDTool by extracting a helper in specgen/prd.go (normalizeBody, HasIntent, frontmatter prefix, validateRelevantFiles) returning the same error codes/messages, so the revision returns the PRD tool's code for a body with no `## Intent` or starting with YAML frontmatter; a relevant file that is not a regular file in the workspace is named in the error

On acceptance build the revised PRD from the submitted body and carry over SpecName, Title and RecommendedSplit unchanged from the PRD under revision; a changed `## Intent` text is accepted; store it and the dispositions in the sink and return OKResult with Terminate=true
Make sure the existing PRD tool tests still pass after the helper extraction

tasks.title: Implement the round loop, stop reasons and the review record
steps: Write the listed tests in specgen/rounds_test.go (TS-09-38 and TS-09-52 as property tests over generated outcome sequences and round limits 1 to 5) and confirm they fail
Create specgen/rounds.go with runRounds(ctx, env, prd PRD, label string, split *splitContext) (PRD, *Review, error) that calls the reviewer interface from task 5 per round

Per round: run the review; zero findings -> record the round with an empty list, count it in rounds_run, stop `no_findings`, PRD unchanged; otherwise run the revision on those findings, mark dispositions accepted/rejected(with reason) from the accepted submission, replace the PRD with the revised one

After a finished revision continue only when the round's review had a critical or major finding and rounds run < limit; all-minor stops with `no_serious_findings`; a critical/major finding at the limit stops with `rounds_exhausted`
Pass the accumulated earlier findings (ids, dispositions, reasons) to both the reviewer and reviser of every round after the first, and the earlier findings to the review tool for its reopens checks

Build the Review record with a single buildReview(rounds, limit, stop) helper so findings_count = accepted+rejected+unanswered and rounds_run = len(rounds); a review/revision that did not finish yields stop `incomplete` which beats every other reason (failure handling itself is added in task 7: leave a clearly named hook returning the incomplete outcome)
Ensure at most `limit` reviews run and exactly one stop reason results for every sequence

tasks.title: Handle failed rounds, budget stops and interrupts without failing the run
steps: Write the listed tests in specgen/rounds_failure_test.go and confirm they fail

In runRounds, when the reviewer or reviser returns an error: if ctx.Err() != nil (user interrupt) return fail("prd_review" or "prd_revision", agentrun.CategoryAborted, err) with no warning and no PRD; otherwise (turn limit, budget, --phase-timeout with a live ctx, refusal, API or internal error) stop the rounds, stop_reason `incomplete`, and return the last complete PRD
Record each finished or failed phase's usage via recordPhase before deciding, so its cost counts toward the spend
Record the warning through o.Run.Warn(envelope.WarnPRDReviewIncomplete, high, ...) naming the spec name, the round, the failed phase and the reason (use agentrun.CategoryOf and the error text)
If a review finished but its revision failed, mark that round's findings `unanswered` with no reason and keep the PRD the review read

Before each review and each revision, when o.TotalBudgetUSD > 0 and o.Run.CostUSD() >= o.TotalBudgetUSD, do not start the phase: stop as for a failed phase with a warning reason naming the total budget, the spend and the ceiling; rounds_run stays 0 when stopped before the first review; a stop between review and revision leaves that review's findings unanswered
Confirm the run's status and exit code are unaffected by these warnings (high warning only)
